name: gemma4-31b-mi300x
description: Quality run: Gemma 4 31B instruction-tuned, bf16 LoRA on one AMD Instinct MI300X (192 GB HBM3, ROCm PyTorch). Merge afterwards (vLLM has no LoRA runtime for Gemma 4).
model_notes: Verify the exact Hub repo id and the licence / gating on the model card before downloading (hf auth login with your own token on the box; never commit it).

The published checkpoint is expected to be multimodal (Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration). train.py loads the class named in config.json, adapts only language-model projections (vision/audio towers are excluded and listed) and merge.py saves the same class, so vLLM serves the merged model like the base. If the multimodal class misbehaves in training, try --model-class Gemma4ForCausalLM and confirm vLLM serves the result.

max_seq_len 8192 rather than 4096: drafter requests are 9.2k chars at p50, 14.4k at p95 and 19.5k at most in the pipeline-check dataset (roughly 3-6k tokens); 4096 would drop the largest multi-layer STR cases. train.py --dry-run prints exact token counts with the real tokenizer; lower it if almost nothing exceeds 4096.
batch 2 x grad_accum 8 = 16 sequences per optimizer step (same tokens per micro-batch as 4 x 4096).

estimates.status: ESTIMATES ONLY - replace with the measured numbers in train_metrics.json during 12-18 Oct
estimates.memory: weights 31e9 x 2 B = ~62 GB (+ ~1 GB vision tower); LoRA r=16 on q/k/v/o/gate/up/down ~0.1-0.15e9 params, fp32 params+grads+Adam ~2 GB; activations with gradient checkpointing at 2 x 8192 tokens ~10-15 GB; chunked NLL keeps the 262k-vocabulary logits small. Expected peak ~80-95 GB of 192 GB: room to raise batch_size to 4, or to keep a small vLLM instance resident (--gpu-memory-utilization <= 0.4) only if really needed.
estimates.wall_clock_per_epoch: ~40-60 min for ~6M training tokens (6 x 31e9 x 6e6 = ~1.1e18 FLOPs at an assumed 25-40% of MI300X bf16 dense peak); plausible range 30-120 min. Tokens per epoch scale with --samples and the teacher's acceptance rate.
estimates.merge: fp32 merge needs ~124 GB (fits in 192 GB); saved as bf16 (~62 GB on disk).
